files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.Attributes.OriginFilterAttribute
files.Summary:
Action filter that validates the Origin request header against a match pattern.
Match pattern rules:

  • null or *: allow all
  • regex (contains ^$*?[): origin must satisfy pattern
  • pipe-delimited: must case-insensitively contain any one part
  • wildcard: must case-insensitively satisfy wildcard pattern
  • plain text: exact case-sensitive match

files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.Attributes.TokenFilterAttribute
files.Summary:
Action filter that validates a request token value against a match pattern.
The value is read from the token header or cookie by default.
Match pattern rules:

  • null or *: allow all
  • regex (contains ^$*?[): value must satisfy pattern
  • pipe-delimited: must case-insensitively contain any one part
  • wildcard: must case-insensitively satisfy wildcard pattern
  • plain text: exact case-sensitive match

files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.Attributes.UserAgentFilterAttribute
files.Summary:
Action filter that validates the User-Agent request header against a match pattern.
Always blocks known bots, spiders and crawlers regardless of match pattern.
Match pattern rules:

  • null or *: allow all
  • regex (contains ^$*?[): user agent must satisfy pattern
  • pipe-delimited: must case-insensitively contain any one part
  • wildcard: must case-insensitively satisfy wildcard pattern

files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.BaseApiController

files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.Cache
files.Summary:
Static class for sharded in-memory caching with auto-generated cache keys, skip conditions, and optional fallback cache.
Default duration is 180 seconds.

  • Skip options: skipWhenAuthenticated (false), skipWhenAdmin (true), skipWhen (custom condition).
  • Pass null as cacheKey to always bypass cache. Pass "" to auto-generate from calling context.

files.Title: SystemLibrary.Common.Framework.App.Client
files.Summary:
Client is a class for all http(s) requests in your project

Uses HttpClient and Polly behind the scenes for features such as reusing tcp connections, retry on 502 and 504 status codes, and optionally a request breaker for 7 seconds, if 25 error codes (404, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 505) occurs in a row

useRetryPolicy: false, will retry once if request is a file request or GET or POST and status code is 502 or 504

Options:

useRetryPolicy:

True: same as 'false', but adds:

  • retries one additional time on 502, 504 GET, POST

- retries up to two times if response is null (timeout/no response)

  • retries once on 401 GET, POST

- retries once on 404 GET

  • retries once on 500 GET, POST

- retries once on 404, 500, 502 504 file request

  • retries once on OPTION, PATCH, HEAD, CONNECT, TRACE
